issues.description: The problem statement and solution expect detect_errors to return a numpy array (npt.NDArray[np.int8]) indicating which shots are good, but the template's function signature for detect_errors declares a return type of list[int]. This mismatch in the declared return type between the template and the specification/solution can confuse students about the expected data structure and lead to type-related errors when they implement or test their solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template's detect_errors signature match the specification and solution by changing its return annotation to npt.NDArray[np.int8] and updating the docstring accordingly (or adjust the problem text to accept list[int]). This ensures students implement and return the expected numpy array type used by downstream code.
